answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 24965 Country: India Title: A lot of people name their daughters "Laiba" .On the internet the meaning of Laiba is given as "leader of the Hoors in Jannah" I asked a local mufti but he said Laiba has no such meaning. Question: A lot of people name their daughters "Laiba" .On the internet the meaning of Laiba is given as "leader of the Hoors in Jannah" I asked a local mufti but he said Laiba has no such meaning. Please clarify whether it is permissible to keep the name Laiba and its real meaning. Answer ID: 24965 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1586/1235/B=1431) Laiba (لاعبہ) means a player while Layba (لائبہ) means thirsty, a woman who stays away from the water. Both these names are not good. We could not get the meaning of Laiba as "Leader of the Hoors in Jannah" in any dictionary, which you have quoted with the reference of internet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
